claim: The name-field theory SURVIVED its kill condition: Play 'fruit tree tracker' went #26 to #1 and held five weeks, Apple downloads 0.46 -> 1.73/day (p=1.9e-06). ASO is a lever, not a path to $100/mo.

body.decision: DEC-335 / DAL-257 (Done). The pre-registered four-week re-measure. Play clock 2026-08-13, Apple 2026-08-19; both dates passed.
body.verdict: THE NAME-FIELD THEORY SURVIVES ITS KILL CONDITION. Do not re-open it. ASO is confirmed as a lever on Apple, aimed at <niche> tracker compounds, and is NOT by itself a path to $100/mo.
body.play_is_the_scored_test: Only the title changed on Play, and the control held: the three orchard-only terms were absent at baseline and are absent now across all 8 captures, with two single-capture flickers at the bottom of a 30-result window (orchard tracker AU #29 on 09-06, backyard orchard AU #23 on 09-17) and nothing else.
body.play_fruit_tree_tracker: AU #26 -> #1, US absent -> #1, HELD AT #1 ON SEVEN CONSECUTIVE WEEKLY CAPTURES over five weeks. Not the day-0 fresh-listing effect the design warned about. Both pre-registered Play predictions met.
body.apple_reported_not_scored: AU fruit tree tracker #7 -> #2 (the pre-registered top 3, met), US #4 -> #2. Across the 36-term block 24 moved, 20 up, 12 entered from absent, 1 dropped. NOT scored: Apple's submission carried name + subtitle (garden -> orchard) + en-US deletion at once, so the orchard terms are not a control on Apple.
body.the_predicted_cost_appeared_late_RETRACT: The day-0 comment on DAL-257 said in bold that the rename's predicted cost 'did not appear' and 'the trade-off this rename was sold on does not exist on Play'. THAT IS RETRACTED. graft tracker and grafting tracker were #1 on both Play storefronts on day 0 and are out of the top 30 on every capture from 2026-08-20 onward. Play had swapped the title and not yet re-indexed the descriptions. Apple did the OPPOSITE and held both at #1 throughout, because the iOS description still carries graft: the two stores weight name vs description differently.

downloads_followed.source: Apple's own App Downloads Standard report (DEC-334), first-time downloads only, excluding the 15 days lost to the DEC-332 handover hole
downloads_followed.the_lift_is_in_search: App Store search 0.26 -> 1.18 downloads/day (4.5x) and search rose as a SHARE of downloads too, 60% -> 68%. That is the only channel downstream of a keyword change. App referrer and web referrer moved by 3 and 2 downloads total.
downloads_followed.both_territories_equally: AU 0.19 -> 0.73/day, US 0.14 -> 0.55/day, both ~3.8x. The en-US deletion is US-only and predicts a US-specific lift; there is not one, so the collapse to one localisation is not what carries this.
downloads_followed.no_pre_existing_ramp: Monthly first-time downloads May 15, Jun 12, Jul 13, Aug 10 (20 observed days), then Sep 16 over 9 observed days. Four flat months then a step on the rename date (DEC-328: check the start date).
downloads_followed.conversion_improved_not_just_exposure: Downloads grew 3.8x while impressions grew 1.6x. More of the people who saw us installed. Strongest single line in the readout.

not_claimed: 1.0.11 shipped 2026-09-13 and the two biggest days are the release day and the one after. Strip them: 10 downloads in 9 days vs 4.2 expected, p = 0.011, effect survives but weakens. DAL-301's 2026-10-15 re-read is now LOAD-BEARING, not housekeeping.
Both storefronts gained their first-ever rating inside the window, date unknown. DEC-237 called ratings the binding constraint, so this is an uncontrolled co-cause.
Seasonality: AU spring would lift AU, but not US by the same 3.8x in northern autumn. Weak evidence against, not proof.

Play's rank win is UNMEASURABLE in downloads (Play Console is Benedict's, RevenueCat inflates Android ~6x, Android has produced US$0 across 4 sales). Play gave the clean rank experiment, Apple the money-bearing funnel. Neither store could answer this alone.
body.series_not_a_diff: data/treesmith-rank-history.csv now holds 8 Play and 7 Apple weekly captures (cron 40 21 * * 0). The two-point diff DAL-257 originally specified would have shown the graft loss with no idea it took a week to arrive, and would never have shown #1 holding for five weeks rather than five hours.
